constraints: Map every acceptance criterion to direct evidence.
Preserve one normalized graph: hooks read its store, platform intents use the platform store, and only that store calls the service boundary.

Prove actual IPC, deep-link, and persisted-input trust boundaries fail closed.
Inspect responsive/native visuals and retain accessibility scope.
Keep coverage, ledgers, skills, docs, Changesets, and release contract synchronized.
Preserve the independently frozen React rc.1 lane.
Keep unexecuted platforms, credential rotation, and publication limits explicit.

target_state.description: A reproducible archive disposition with every bounded Tauri criterion proven, all scope limits named, and zero unsupported release or publication claims.
